description: PROP-BILL-057 (health check) and PROP-BILL-058 (service boundary) tests at cross-cutting.test.ts:146-218 remain tautological. They test locally-defined inline functions (buildHealthResponse) and hardcoded string arrays, not the actual production code. The prior review (CF-003) acknowledged this as acceptable for DI testing pattern, and the contract notes it. However, the contract's CRIT-017 ('npm run test:billing exits 0 with 142 tests passed') counts these toward the 142 total. A Phase 3 adversary should be aware these 4 tests contribute to the count but verify no production behavior.
